sections.title: Background summary
sections.summary: What fills the whole screen behind your content: a solid color, a photo, or a looping video.

sections.title: Basic Config summary
sections.summary: Screen-level behaviour: entrance animations, cached media, a device-permission prompt, and auto-advance.

sections.title: Paywall Body summary
sections.summary: The paywall's words — the headline and subtitle (with full typography) and the feature-benefit bullet list, including each bullet's box style, padding, and per-bullet title / subtitle / icon styling.

sections.title: Paywall Footer summary
sections.summary: The bottom of the paywall — the purchase (subscribe) button and its label and box styling, the auto-renew disclosure note, the footer background and element order, and the restore / terms-of-use / privacy-policy legal links with their URLs and styling.

sections.title: Paywall Header summary
sections.summary: The paywall's top bar — an optional close (X) button (its icon color, which side it sits on, and whether it appears at once or after a short delay) and an optional restore-purchases link with its own wording and typography.

sections.title: Paywall Media summary
sections.summary: The paywall's featured image or video — its source, how it fills its area, height, corner rounding, spacing, where it sits relative to the header and body, and an optional dark fade overlay for text readability.

sections.title: Paywall Subscriptions summary
sections.summary: The plan picker — how the subscription cards are arranged, where the selection checkbox sits, the plans themselves, the selected/unselected card styling and spacing, and each plan's name / price / note / billing-period labels, badge, and checkbox styling.

sections.title: Paywall screen
sections.summary: The Paywall screen is built from the sections below. This overview shows what each section does and links to its full guide — open any section’s guide to see every setting it offers.
